008package paint.ui.dialogs.project;
009
010import paint.shared.config.paintconfig.PaintConfig;
011import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
012import paint.shared.utils.PaintPrefs;
013
014import javax.swing.*;
015
016import java.io.File;
017import java.nio.file.Path;
018import java.util.function.Consumer;
019import java.util.function.Supplier;
020
021import static paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectDialog.DialogMode;
022
023/**
024 * Controller for ProjectDialog. It reacts to UI events coming from the panels,
025 * controls enabling/disabling of buttons, performs validations, and manages the
026 * interaction with the background worker (through QuadRunnable and Supplier/Consumer callbacks).
027 */
028public class ProjectDialogController {
029
030    private final DialogMode          mode;
031    private final JDialog             dialog;
032    private final PaintConfig         paintConfig;
033    private       boolean             workerStarted = false;
034
035    // Project root getter/setter supplied by the dialog
036    private final Supplier<Path>      getProjectPath;
037    private final Consumer<Path>      setProjectPath;
038
039    // UI panels
040    private final ProjectPathsPanel   paths;
041    private final SquaresParamsPanel  params; // null in VIEWER mode
042    private final ExperimentsPanel    experiments;
043    private final BottomBarPanel      bottom;
044
045    // Worker logic references provided by ProjectDialog
046    private final QuadRunnable        startWorker;
047    private final Supplier<Thread>    getWorker;
048    private final Runnable            setCancelled;
049    private final Runnable            clearCancelled;
050
051    // A callback provided by ProjectDialog to re-enable ALL UI elements
052    private final Runnable            enableAllUiFromDialog;
053
054    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
055    //  Constructor
056    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
057
058    public ProjectDialogController(
059            DialogMode         mode,
060            JDialog            dialog,
061            PaintConfig        paintConfig,
062            Supplier<Path>     getProjectPath,
063            Consumer<Path>     setProjectPath,
064            ProjectPathsPanel  paths,
065            SquaresParamsPanel params,
066            ExperimentsPanel   experiments,
067            BottomBarPanel     bottom,
068            QuadRunnable       startWorker,
069            Supplier<Thread>   getWorker,
070            Runnable           setCancelled,
071            Runnable           clearCancelled,
072            Runnable           enableAllUiFromDialog
073    ) {
074        this.mode           = mode;
075        this.dialog         = dialog;
076        this.paintConfig    = paintConfig;
077        this.getProjectPath = getProjectPath;
078        this.setProjectPath = setProjectPath;
079        this.paths          = paths;
080        this.params         = params;
081        this.experiments    = experiments;
082        this.bottom         = bottom;
083        this.startWorker    = startWorker;
084        this.getWorker      = getWorker;
085        this.setCancelled   = setCancelled;
086        this.clearCancelled = clearCancelled;
087
088        this.enableAllUiFromDialog = enableAllUiFromDialog;
089    }
090
091    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
092    //  Initialization
093    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
094
095    public void init() {
096
097        // Browsing
098        paths.onBrowseProject(this::handleBrowseProject);
099        paths.onBrowseImages(this::handleBrowseImages);
100
101        // Text changes → OK may update
102        paths.onRootsChanged(this::updateOk);
103        experiments.onSelectionChanged(this::updateOk);
104
105        // Parameter changes (TrackMate only)
106        if (params != null) {
107            params.onParamsChanged(this::updateOk);
108        }
109
110        // Sweep toggle
111        bottom.onVerboseToggle(this::onVerboseToggle);
112        bottom.onSweepToggle(this::onSweepToggle);
113
114        // OK/Cancel
115        bottom.onOk(this::handleOk);
116        bottom.onCancel(this::handleCancel);
117
118        // Initial state
119        updateOk();
120    }
121
122    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
123    //  OK
124    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
125
126    private void handleOk() {
127
128        if (mode == DialogMode.TRACKMATE_BATCH) {
129            final String img = paths.imagesRootText().trim();
130            if (!new File(img).isDirectory()) {
131                JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
132                        dialog,
133                        "The Images Root directory does not exist. Please select a valid directory.",
134                        "Invalid Images Root",
135                        JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE
136                );
137                return;
138            }
139        }
140
141        PaintLogger.debugf("ProjectDialogController.handleOK - project path: %s", paths.projectRootText());
142        PaintLogger.debugf("ProjectDialogController.handleOK - images  path: %s", paths.imagesRootText());
143        PaintLogger.debugf("ProjectDialogController.handleOK - experiments : %s", experiments.selectedExperimentNames());
144
145        PaintPrefs.putString("Path", "Project Root", paths.projectRootText());
146        PaintPrefs.putString("Path", "Images Root", paths.imagesRootText());
147
148        // Persist experiment selection if requested (clear section, then write only selected)
149        if (bottom.isSaveExperimentsSelected()) {
150            PaintConfig.removeSection("Experiments"); // clears entire section + autosaves
151            for (String name : experiments.selectedExperimentNames()) {
152                PaintConfig.setBoolean("Experiments", name, true);
153            }
154        }
155
156        clearCancelled.run();
157        workerStarted = true;
158
159        Runnable uiDisable = () -> {
160            setInputsEnabled(false);
161            bottom.showRunning();
162        };
163
164        Runnable uiEnable = () -> {
165            setInputsEnabled(true);
166            bottom.resetOk(mode == DialogMode.VIEWER);
167        };
168
169        Runnable onSuccess = () -> {
170            if (mode == DialogMode.TRACKMATE_SINGLE || mode == DialogMode.VIEWER) {
171                // In SINGLE mode, OK just opens the modeless TrackMateSingleDialog.
172                // TrackMate runs later from that dialog, so don't claim success here.
173                bottom.resetOk(false); // or bottom.resetOk(validToRun()); if you prefer
174                return;
175            }
176
177            PaintLogger.blankline();
178            PaintLogger.infof("Operation completed successfully.");
179            bottom.showCompleted(mode == DialogMode.VIEWER);
180        };
181
182        Runnable onFailure = () -> {
183            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
184                    dialog,
185                    "Operation finished with errors. Check the log.",
186                    "Warning",
187                    JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE
188            );
189        };
190
191        startWorker.run(uiDisable, uiEnable, onSuccess, onFailure);
192    }
193
194    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
195    //  CANCEL
196    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
197
198    private void handleCancel() {
199
200        setCancelled.run();
201        Thread t = getWorker.get();
202
203        bottom.showStopping();
204
205        // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
206        // CASE 1 — Worker still running → perform real cancellation
207        // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
208        if (t != null && t.isAlive()) {
209            PaintLogger.infof("Cancellation requested — waiting for worker to finish...");
210            new Thread(() -> handleWorkerShutdown(t), "ForceShutdownWatcher").start();
211            return;
212        }
213
214        // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
215        // CASE 2 — Cancel BEFORE worker started (invalid dialog state)
216        // Re-enable full UI so user can fix input
217        // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
218        if (!workerStarted) {
219            PaintLogger.infof("Cancellation before start — closing dialog.");
220            clearCancelled.run();
221            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(dialog::dispose);
222            return;
223        }
224
225        // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
226        // CASE 3 — Worker started and is DONE → treat select Cancel as dialog close
227        // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
228        PaintLogger.infof("Cancel after completion — closing dialog.");
229        paint.ui.console.PaintConsoleWindow.closeIfVisible();
230        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(dialog::dispose);
231        clearCancelled.run();
232    }
233
234    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
235    //  Worker Shutdown
236    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
237
238    private void handleWorkerShutdown(Thread thread) {
239        try {
240            thread.join();
241        } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}
242        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> finishWorkerShutdown(thread));
243    }
244
245    private void finishWorkerShutdown(Thread thread) {
246
247        if (thread.isAlive()) {
248            PaintLogger.errorf("Worker thread did not stop — forcing JVM halt.");
249            Runtime.getRuntime().halt(0);
250            return;
251        }
252
253        PaintLogger.infof("Worker thread terminated cleanly.");
254
255        workerStarted = false;
256        bottom.resetOk(true);
257        clearCancelled.run();
258
259        enableFullUI();
260    }
261
262    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
263    //  Sweep Toggle
264    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
265
266    private void onSweepToggle(boolean selected) {
267
268        if (selected) {
269            final Path root = getProjectPath.get();
270            final Path sweepFile = root.resolve("Paint Sweep Configuration.json");
271
272            if (!java.nio.file.Files.exists(sweepFile)) {
273
274                int res = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(
275                        dialog,
276                        "The file \"Paint Sweep Configuration.json\" does not exist in the project root.\n\n" +
277                                "Do you want to create it now with default sweep settings?",
278                        "Sweep Configuration Missing",
279                        JOptionPane.YES_NO_OPTION,
280                        JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE
281                );
282
283                if (res == JOptionPane.YES_OPTION) {
284                    try {
285                        paintConfig.setSweepDefaults(root);
286
287                        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
288                                dialog,
289                                "Sweep configuration file has been created:\n" +
290                                        sweepFile.toAbsolutePath() +
291                                        "\nYou should edit that file to enable the desired sweep options.",
292                                "Sweep File Created",
293                                JOptionPane.INFORMATION_MESSAGE
294                        );
295                    } catch (Exception ex) {
296                        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
297                                dialog,
298                                "Failed to create sweep configuration:\n" + ex.getMessage(),
299                                "Error",
300                                JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE
301                        );
302                    }
303                } else {
304                    bottom.setSweepSelected(false);
305                }
306            }
307        }
308
309        updateOk();
310    }
311
312    private void onVerboseToggle(boolean selected) {
313    }
314
315    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
316    //  Browse handlers
317    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
318
319    private void handleBrowseProject(File dir) {
320        updateProjectRoot(dir.toPath());
321    }
322
323    private void handleBrowseImages(File ignored) {
324        updateOk();
325    }
326
327    private void updateProjectRoot(Path newRoot) {
328        setProjectPath.accept(newRoot);
329        bottom.updateOkEnabled(validToRun());
330    }
331
332    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
333    //  Utility
334    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
335
336    private void updateOk() {
337        bottom.updateOkEnabled(validToRun());
338    }
339
340    private boolean validToRun() {
341        if (mode == DialogMode.VIEWER) {
342            return paths.isProjectRootValid();
343        }
344        return paths.isProjectRootValid() && experiments.anySelected();
345    }
346
347    /**
348     * Enables/disables all interactive UI elements EXCEPT the Cancel button.
349     */
350    private void setInputsEnabled(boolean enabled) {
351
352        // Disable Project + Images root fields
353        paths.setEnabled(enabled, mode);
354
355        // Disable TrackMate / Squares parameters
356        if (params != null) {
357            params.setEnabled(enabled);
358        }
359
360        experiments.setEnabled(enabled);
361
362        bottom.setEnabled(enabled);
363
364        if (!enabled) {
365            bottom.keepCancelEnabled();
366        }
367    }
368
369    /**
370     * Restores full dialog UI after cancellation-before-start.
371     */
372    private void enableFullUI() {
373        enableAllUiFromDialog.run();          // Re-enable all fields/buttons
374        bottom.resetOk(validToRun());         // Restore OK button state
375    }
376
377    /**
378     * Functional interface used to launch worker logic with four callbacks.
379     */
380    @FunctionalInterface
381    public interface QuadRunnable {
382        @SuppressWarnings("unused")
383        void run(Runnable a, Runnable b, Runnable c, Runnable d);
384    }
385}
